entries.reason: The scrub placeholder the lab's record-graph-fixtures writes in place of the recorded access token: an unsigned JWT with alg none and the one claim {"scrubbed":true}. A replay signs in with it; nothing accepts it.
The same placeholder as the value of "access_token": the recorded token reply with its token scrubbed.
The same placeholder, where the README says what the fixtures' tokens are.
Base64 of a result document, which W4.3's cases give as bytes (a BOM case and one that isn't UTF-8): Base64 of '{"attachments":' starts with eyJ as a JWT header does. No token.
RFC 8032 section 7.1's test keys 1 and 2 as PKCS#8 Base64: published, known to everyone, never signing anything real (docs/decisions.md 2026-10-05 W4.3 point 6).
RFC 8032's test key 1 inside a PRIVATE KEY block both verifiers must refuse as a public key file (the case ed25519-private-key-rfc8032-test-1).
The same block: a PRIVATE KEY PEM of RFC 8032's test key 1, a key file the verifiers refuse.

The test-only timestamp authority's EC key (W4.4): made once for the vectors, trusted by no Worker build and by no verifier without a CA file a test writes; it signs the vectors' tokens and nothing else.
The first line of that same key's PEM body.
